name: Vampire's Fall 2
description:
About This Game


A World Ruled by Vampires

Vampire’s Fall 2 invites you back into a bleak and haunting realm, continuing the legacy of the dark fantasy RPG Vampire’s Fall: Origins. Taking place two centuries later, vampires rule the world, and humans are little more than slaves and food for the aristocratic elite. A hero is needed to save humanity, or seal its fate.

A Seamless Open World

Explore a handcrafted 2D world where immersion never breaks. Towns breathe with quiet life, the wilderness hides adventure alongside threats, and enemies that are visibly traversing the world, letting you decide when and how to engage. Movement, exploration, and combat flow together naturally—there are no loading screens to pull you out of the experience. 

Become a Vampire

Early in your journey, you embrace the curse that defines your path. Becoming a vampire unlocks powerful abilities and reshapes gameplay, granting access to unique skills and mechanics that grow stronger as you do.

Tactical, Turn-Based Combat

Combat in Vampire’s Fall 2 is deliberate and strategic. Battles take place directly within the world and follow a turn-based system where every action matters. Attacks, abilities, and the use of HP and FP potions all consume turns, forcing you to weigh risk and reward. Success comes from planning, managing resources, and adapting to each enemy’s strengths.

Deep Character Progression

As you level up your character, each level grants randomized bonuses, giving you meaningful control over your build. Focus on defense, damage, or balance, and evolve your character to match your playstyle.

Weapons, Builds, and Customization

Wield 9 weapon types, from maces to katanas, each with distinct advantages. Four skill trees—Anger, Control, Vitality, and Deceit—allow deep customization and diverse, powerful builds.

The world is teeming with loot that you can obtain from quests, fighting enemies, or stumbling upon treasure in the wilds. All gear changes the visual identity of your character and increases the core stats to allow you to further specialize in the type of combat you enjoy the most!

Player vs Player and Community

PvP allows you to test your build and tactics against other players whenever you’re ready. Integrated chat sits conveniently within the UI, letting you communicate without interrupting gameplay. With cross-platform multiplayer between PC, Android and iOS, the community is always within reach.

A Pure RPG Experience

Vampire’s Fall 2 is designed to be fully immersive—no ads, no distractions. Just a focused RPG experience where atmosphere, systems, and progression work together seamlessly.

Step Into the Night

Your choices shape your legend. Master your vampiric powers, outthink your enemies, and carve your destiny in a world that does not forgive mistakes.
short_desc: Rise as a vampire in a handcrafted 2D dark-fantasy RPG. Master devastating powers, confront horrific enemies, and forge your destiny in a world shattered by a brutal civil war between humans and vampires.
